# v1.0.0

Java 17 educational sample with two Maven modules. Includes two conventional JARs,
an executable Fat JAR, three POMs and SHA-256 checksums.

**Intentionally vulnerable dependencies. Do not use in production.**

`sample-app` depends on `sample-logging`, which brings `log4j-core:2.14.1`
and `log4j-api:2.14.1` transitively. The Fat JAR preserves Maven metadata.

Expected findings for `log4j-core:2.14.1` include:

- CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell): JNDI lookup remote code execution.
- CVE-2021-45046: lookup code execution in certain configurations.
- CVE-2021-45105: recursive lookup denial of service.
- CVE-2021-44832: JDBC appender code execution in certain configurations.

See the [Log4j security advisories](https://logging.apache.org/security.html).
Results depend on the scanner database; this list is not exhaustive.
Dependency detection does not prove exploitability. This app logs a fixed message
and contains no network services, endpoints or exploit code.
